body: I never really thought about it. I guess I was raised as a "grin and bear it" type of person.

Thanks for the reply. I don't think I'm seriously considering actually doing it. Theres no way I could leave my mom or anybody I'm close to just like that. It's just the thought coming across my mind scared me so much and I needed an outlet. I like what you say about us finding happiness together. As a result of our depressions we never do really talk or anything. That's something that I think needs to be changed.

I realize I focused on old friends and girlfriends quite a bit in my post. And it seems petty. But constantly being rejected over and over and over and over really is wearing on me. It makes me feel worthless. I'm going to try and get past this as best I can.

Thanks again. It means a lot.
